title: Ender Chest on Death
description: Ender Chest on Death is a lightweight Minecraft datapack that gives players exactly one Ender Chest when they die, without enabling keepInventory, so you can have a chance to get some items back!
body: Ender Chest on Death is a lightweight Minecraft datapack that gives players exactly one Ender Chest when they die, without enabling keepInventory,  so you can have a chance to get some stuff! It is a datapak that works on all versions so install now.
